Original site of Lion's Arch Keep. Here in 1079 AE, the White Mantle was defeated by Queen Salma of Kryta and her Shining Blade, at the Battle of Lion's Arch.
Original site of the Lion's Court statue and fountain, destroyed by the forces of Scarlet Briar in 1327 AE.
Orr is a scary place. Scary! But I've got many things. Shiny things. Things that can help you. Interested?
Osborn, good to see you. You here for the hunt?
Other Vanguard soldiers have put down their arms, for the time being, to help the civilians reinforce our position. Slowly, our defenses are taking form.
Other than the flowing lava and intense heat, this reminds me of the Depths.
Our Awakened never made that mistake.
Our Voice is optimistic that we will have an opportunity to find new allies against Jormag. I am less certain, but the Voice has never steered us wrong.
Our allies are assaulting the Aetherblade hideout.
Our allies are preparing to assault the Aetherblade hideout.
Our allies have taken Foulbear Kraal.
Our ambient magic readings are high. It must be related.
Our attacks are just sliding off its slick skin.
translate: Наши атаки просто соскальзывают с его скользкой кожи..

english: Our bivouac's been compromised. We have to contain the Risen and destroy our corrupted!
Our camp is barely holding out against the graveling attacks. The scholars say the only hope is to kill one of their patriarchs.
translate: Наш Лагерь едва сдерживает атаки грэвелингов. Ученые говорят, что единственная надежда — убить одного из их патриархов.

english: Our caravan! I was taking merchants south to sell wares. Knew it was dangerous, but they paid up front.
Our cattle are known all across Tyria. Even charr in the Black Citadel have heard of our famous Claypool burgers.
Our choices are victory or death, and you're worried about appearances?
Our city is safe from outside threat—for now.
Our dead will thank you for it when they're Awakened—less stiffness, better complexion, fewer vermin...
Our engineers have been deployed to establish a defensive perimeter.
Our equipment better get here soon.
Our fallen mother will return to us.
Our golem is without peer. Still, it would be stronger if they just followed my suggestions.
Our golems, in the hands of the Inquest? I don't care what it costs. Get them back!
Our invasion force could use your help across the Strait, in Orr. We'll continue providing cover here.
Our job is to find her and extract her. Stay close. We're going deep into smokelicker territory.

Our krewe inside the Anthill needs assistance educating skritt about the dangers of Thaumanova's chaotic material. Then there's the Luminates pest problem—insects, Inquest, and elementals. Squash a few of those, and you'll increase our productivity by as much as thirty-five percent.
Our logical probability of success is improving, %str1%. Step by step, we're achieving victory—but you must be sure we do not fall short when the end is near.
translate: Вероятность нашего успеха растет, %str1%. Шаг за шагом мы приближаемся к победе, но ты должен быть уверен, что мы не оступимся, когда конец будет близок.

english: Our lord Balthazar's champion has come!
Our losses have been great, but now, we've all been forged in the crucible of battle. We are united under a singular purpose.

Our main focus is preparing our golem, the RCK-7550, for the golem battle at Battleground Plaza. We've developed a process to siphon energy from the earth and use it to augment our golem. It produces great results.
Our mission is simple. We are here to defend those threatened by the dragons.
Our mission is to rescue as many slaves as possible, though a sylvari prisoner named Hywel is top priority. He's a warden of exceptional skill.
translate: Наша миссия — спасти как можно больше рабов, хотя приоритетная цель — сильвари по имени Hywel. Он страж исключительного мастерства.

english: Our next target. Pick up the pace, people! We've got a party to crash.
Our odds against the destroyers are better together. Stay close.
Our orders arrive just before the raids. It's as if someone is sending us away so bandits can swoop in unchallenged.
translate: Наши приказы приходят как раз перед налетами. Как будто кто-то специально отсылает нас прочь, чтобы бандиты могли беспрепятственно действовать.

english: Our paths diverged long ago. I chose the Dream of our people. You, a twisted phantasm.
Our people in the Vanguard will keep this place a secret, one way or another. We also have a secondary entrance, for our non-human agents. Keeps things discreet.
Our poor servants. So heroic. So noble. So ill-prepared for battle.
Our recent population increase has led to the overhunting of these rodents.
Our rifle is light, adjustable, and versatile. It is ideal for rapid responses.
Our sages did not return. Where are they? I'm worried.
Our search for Ascension won't end here!
Our ship came down just north of here. We were torn from the sky and strewn all across this valley.
Our team is strategizing a plan to remove said demon from its power source: a ley line housed within the mine—
Our time is now. We rise from the shadows to claim what is ours!
Our tribe is struggling to survive a flood of undead surging into this area.
Our tribe's shaman is attempting to cleanse the oasis as we speak. If you are swift, there may still be time for you to aid her.
Our village, Lapatl Grounds, is just south of here. We're fighting to keep the undead from taking it. They came up from the deep to lay siege to our grounds.
Outgoing damage is increased by 2%% for each stack.
translate: Исходящий урон увеличивается на 2%% за каждый стак.

english: Outlander! See you've got yourself some wings fit for soaring. How about putting them to use?
Outlander, the village needs new livestock. Help me wrangle these marmoxes!
Outposts have been established around Kralkatorrik. Now your allies must expand their influence over each region.
Over here! Please. I need help!
Over time, the human settlements grew and spread. Simultaneously, centaur tribes began to organize their efforts to hold and retake their lands.

Over two centuries ago, this massive iron cauldron was used by the charr to ignite the Searing—a destructive wave that decimated their human foe. Though cold and silent, the relic's power still abides.
Over two hundred years ago, we took our land back.

translate: Ой! И Waine повержен окончательно! Похоже, победитель забирает меч противника в качестве трофея. Давайте поприветствуем нашего нового чемпиона!

Pact choppers have landed to evacuate the wounded and take any able-bodied fighters higher in the canopy.

Pact forces are fortifying their position in Gallant's Folly.

However, the krait and the minions of Zhaitan have been disrupting the supply routes. They must be dealt with before any assault can take place.  If you are willing to help, seek out Magister Kimberly on the isle.
Pact forces failed to destroy the Claw of Jormag. Corruption continues to spread through the area.

Pact forces have begun their assault on the Temple of Balthazar. They march toward the Altar of Betrayal.
Pact forces have breached the walls of Infinity Coil and are assaulting the facility's reactors.
Pact soldiers are fighting the Risen for control of Stentor Cannonade.
